summary: Only one blocking issue requires resolution: a copy-paste caption error in the manuscript where the N=60,000 subfigure is mislabelled as N=500. This is a pure manuscript text error introduced at the report-writing stage. No code, data, analysis, or figures need to change; a single directed text correction is sufficient.

decisions.rationale: The figure file referenced is correctly curves_size60000.png and the underlying image is correct. The error is solely in the LaTeX caption string, which was copy-pasted from the N=500 subfigure immediately above and never updated. Fixing the caption text in the manuscript fully resolves the issue without any re-running of tasks.

report_directives.text: In the LaTeX source, locate the subfigure that includes '../figures/curves_size60000.png' (fig:curves60k, approximately L327–L336). Change its \caption{} from '$N{=}500$.' to '$N{=}60{,}000$.' and recompile the PDF. Verify in the compiled output that the two subfigures in fig:curves_extremes are labelled N=500 (left) and N=60,000 (right) respectively, consistent with the surrounding text at L345–L349.
